info.name: Poha
info.description: A light and healthy dish made from flattened rice, tossed with onions, green chilies, mustard seeds, and garnished with fresh coriander and a dash of lemon for a tangy kick. A staple breakfast choice!

info.name: Upit
info.description: A warm and comforting South Indian semolina dish cooked with ghee, mustard seeds, curry leaves, and fresh vegetables. Perfectly spiced and satisfying.

info.name: Vada Pav
info.description: A classic Mumbai street food, featuring a spicy mashed potato fritter sandwiched in a soft pav (bread) and served with tangy chutneys for a burst of flavor.

info.name: Batata Vada Sambhar
info.description: Golden-crisp potato fritters paired with steaming hot sambhar  a tangy and spicy lentil soup with a hint of tamarind. A unique combination!

info.name: Misal Pav
info.description: A fiery Maharashtrian curry made with sprouted lentils, topped with crunchy farsan (fried gram flour snacks), onions, and a squeeze of lemon, served with pav. A perfect mix of textures and flavors!

info.name: Puri Bhaji
info.description: Golden, puffed puris paired with a flavorful potato curry cooked with aromatic spices, making it a hearty and timeless Indian delight.

info.name: Sheera
info.description: A rich and velvety semolina pudding infused with ghee, cardamom, and saffron, sweetened to perfection and garnished with nuts.

info.name: Pav Bhaji
info.description: A luscious blend of spiced mashed vegetables served with buttery, toasted pav buns, topped with a dollop of butter and a side of tangy onions and lemon.

info.name: Dahi Vada
info.description: Soft lentil dumplings soaked in creamy yogurt, topped with tangy tamarind chutney, spicy green chutney, and a sprinkle of aromatic spices.

info.name: Rice Plate
info.description: A wholesome and hearty meal featuring steamed rice, three soft chapatis, flavorful varan (dal), a dry sabji, curry, fresh salad, and crispy papad. A complete traditional Indian thali experience!

info.name: Bhaji Chapati
info.description: A simple yet fulfilling dish with two freshly prepared chapatis, a flavorful vegetable curry, and a side of tangy pickle for a burst of flavor.

info.name: Varan Bhat
info.description: Comfort food at its best  fluffy rice served with traditional Maharashtrian dal, mildly spiced and tempered with ghee and cumin.

info.name: Shabudana Vada
info.description: Crispy fritters made from tapioca pearls and mashed potatoes, deep-fried to golden perfection and served hot with tangy chutney.

info.name: Shabudana Khichdi
info.description: A savory dish made from soaked tapioca pearls, cooked with roasted peanuts, green chilies, and a touch of lime. A popular choice during fasting days.

info.name: Kat Dosa
info.description: A bold and spicy South Indian specialty featuring a thick dosa layered with robust masala and a fiery red chutney. Ideal for spice lovers!

info.name: Mysore Masala Dosa
info.description: A crispy dosa spread with a spicy Mysore style chutney and stuffed with a rich potato filling. A South Indian classic with a unique twist!

info.name: Sponge Dosa
info.description: Soft, fluffy dosas served with aromatic sambhar and coconut chutney. A perfect choice for those who enjoy light, spongy textures.

info.name: Paper Dosa
info.description: A large, ultra-thin dosa thats crisp and golden, served with a variety of chutneys and piping hot sambhar. A delightful visual and culinary treat!

info.name: Set Dosa
info.description: A set of small, thick dosas with a soft center, served with tangy sambhar and chutneys, offering a wholesome and filling meal.

info.name: Tomato Omelette (Eggless)
info.description: A vegetarian delight made with a batter of chickpea flour, spiced with chopped tomatoes, onions, and coriander. Served hot and packed with nutrition.

info.name: Uttapam
info.description: A thick, pancake-like South Indian dish, topped with a medley of onions, tomatoes, and green chilies, served with sambhar and chutney.

info.name: Masala Dosa
info.description: A golden-brown dosa filled with a delicious spiced potato mixture, served with sambhar and coconut chutney. The ultimate South Indian comfort food.

info.name: Sada Dosa
info.description: A simple, plain dosa, perfectly crisp on the outside and soft inside, served with sambhar and an array of chutneys.

info.name: Sada Uttapam
info.description: A plain version of uttapam with a soft texture, served with traditional South Indian accompaniments. Ideal for a light meal.

info.name: Idli
info.description: A fluffy and flavorful South Indian delight, perfect to start your day or indulge in a light, savory treat.

info.name: Udid Vada
info.description: Crispy, golden fritters made with urad dal, perfectly spiced and served with tangy chutney and sambar. A crunchy delight in every bite!

info.name: Chai
info.description: A cup of traditional Indian tea brewed with milk, sugar, and aromatic spices like cardamom and ginger. Refreshing and energizing!

info.name: Coffee
info.description: Freshly brewed coffee with a rich aroma and bold taste, served hot for a perfect start to your day.

info.name: Lemon Tea
info.description: A light and tangy tea infused with the zesty flavor of lemon. A refreshing and invigorating drink.

info.name: Lassi
info.description: A creamy yogurt based drink, lightly sweetened and flavored with cardamom. A traditional and cooling beverage.

info.name: Cold Coffee
info.description: Chilled, creamy coffee blended with milk and sugar. Perfect for beating the heat while enjoying rich coffee flavors.

info.name: Paneer Masala
info.description: Soft, fresh cubes of paneer (Indian cottage cheese) cooked in a velvety tomato-onion gravy. This dish is enhanced with fragrant spices like garam masala, kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves), and a touch of cream, delivering a harmonious balance of rich flavors. Garnished with coriander and served steaming hot, its the perfect indulgence for paneer lovers.

info.name: Kaju Masala
info.description: A royal delicacy featuring cashew nuts roasted to golden perfection, simmered in a luxurious gravy made from cashew paste, cream, and aromatic spices. This mildly spiced dish is enriched with the essence of cardamom, cloves, and saffron, offering a delightful fusion of sweetness and spice. Its a favorite for those craving a rich and festive flavor.

info.name: Dal Tadka
info.description: A quintessential Punjabi dish made with a combination of yellow lentils (toor dal) slow-cooked until creamy. The dish is elevated by a sizzling tempering of ghee, cumin seeds, garlic, and whole red chilies. This aromatic tadka is poured over the dal, infusing it with a robust flavor. Served with rice or chapati, its hearty and soul-warming.

info.name: Jeera Rice
info.description: Fragrant basmati rice cooked to perfection, infused with the earthy aroma of toasted cumin seeds and tempered with ghee for a rich yet light flavor. Garnished with fresh coriander, this dish is a versatile accompaniment, complementing the bold flavors of curries and dals alike.
